title: VA-02: recommendation identity held for one-to-many mapping
summary: VA-02 remains In Review because the Phase 56P local action combines 2 distinct official recommendations in GAO-25-106874.
key_findings: Phase 56P action: VA should independently update the total life-cycle cost estimate and integrated master schedule for its electronic health-record modernization effort.
Official identity: held; no single official recommendation identity assigned.
Affected component: Department of Veterans Affairs; Electronic Health Record Modernization Integration Office.
Current GAO status: Open; status period: Current GAO product page.
Agency response: VA concurred in principle but limited its planned artifacts to the current Oracle contract. GAO said that scope was insufficient for either full life-cycle recommendation.
Continuation rule: Preserve VA-02 as the parent local action and create recommendation-specific child records before publication; do not collapse Recommendations 1 and 2.
why_it_matters: The crosswalk replaces a letter-level local reference with an inspectable official report-and-recommendation identity where the evidence supports exactly one match.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves local action key VA-02 as a crosswalk rather than an official identifier.
Separates official recommendation identity, affected entity, GAO status, agency response, implementation evidence, closure, and outcome.

Preserves both candidates: GAO-25-106874 Recommendation 1: Develop a reliable life-cycle cost estimate for the full electronic health record modernization program. | GAO-25-106874 Recommendation 2: Develop an integrated master schedule for the full electronic health record modernization program.
evidence_limits: An agency response, concurrence, planned date, submission, or artifact under review does not by itself establish implementation or closure.
GAO recommendation status is not interchangeable with the Phase 56F entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, value, or causation.
A one-to-many local-action mapping cannot be published as one official recommendation identity.
